name: NotebookLM Studio
examples_zh: 把 3 篇 Transformer 论文 PDF 和一段 YouTube 课程导入 NotebookLM，生成中文播客脚本、测验和思维导图。
导入竞品帮助中心 URL，生成 FAQ 学习卡片、功能对比表和客服培训测验。
根据会议纪要和设计文档生成学习型幻灯片、信息图和复习抽认卡。
examples_en: Import three Transformer paper PDFs and a YouTube lecture into NotebookLM, then generate a Chinese podcast script, quiz, and mind map.
Import competitor help-center URLs and create FAQ flashcards, a feature comparison table, and a support-training quiz.
Generate a study slide deck, infographic, and review flashcards from meeting notes and design documents.
description_zh: NotebookLM 学习工作室：导入多种来源，生成播客、测验、抽认卡、思维导图等学习产物
description_en: NotebookLM Studio: import sources and generate podcasts, quizzes, flashcards, mind maps and more
